articles.title: acadplot added to PyPI
articles.summary: AcadPlot, a new plotting tool built on matplotlib, simplifies generating publication-quality plots and subplots for research papers. It features an academic Inconsolata-style setup and LaTeX rendering, making it ideal for scientific documentation and presentations. This tool helps researchers create professional visualizations efficiently, enhancing the clarity and impact of their work for a global audience.

articles.title: Remembrance, Resilience, and 911 Advances in Public Safety
articles.summary: Commemorating the twenty-fifth anniversary of September 11, 2001, this article reflects on the lives lost during the devastating terrorist attacks. It prompts readers to remember the victims and consider the enduring legacy and profound impact of 9/11. The piece likely explores the historical significance and what is owed to those affected by this pivotal international tragedy.

articles.title: Bill Kerby Dead: ‘The Rose,’ ‘Last American Hero’ Screenwriter Was 88
articles.summary: Maverick screenwriter Bill Kerby, a notable figure in Hollywood, has passed away. He is widely recognized for crafting the initial draft of the popular Bette Midler-starring rock drama 'The Rose'. Kerby's diverse filmography also includes significant contributions to movies like 'The Last American Hero', 'The Gravy Train', and 'Hooper'. His unique storytelling prowess left a distinctive mark on the entertainment industry.
